metadata.description: Custom Coding Agents Plugins for Research Software Engineering (RSE) and Scientific Computing tasks

plugins.name: scientific-domain-applications
plugins.description: Domain-specific scientific computing agents and skills for astronomy, astrophysics, and multidimensional data analysis with AstroPy and Xarray.

plugins.name: scientific-python-development
plugins.description: Agents and skills for Scientific Python development following community best practices. Covers packaging, testing, code quality, environment management with pixi, and documentation architecture.

plugins.name: holoviz-visualization
plugins.description: Expert agents and comprehensive skills for interactive data visualization using the HoloViz ecosystem including Panel, hvPlot, HoloViews, Datashader, GeoViews, Colorcet, and Lumen.

plugins.name: ai-research-workflows
plugins.description: Skills-first research workflows for Research Software Engineers and Researchers: research, plan, experiment, implement, validate, reproduce, harden, and handoff — interactive when you want collaboration, direct when you don't.

plugins.name: project-management
plugins.description: Project lifecycle management for research software. Covers onboarding, documentation quality, handoff readiness, and community health file generation for open-source projects.

plugins.name: gaia-data-downloader
plugins.description: Generate and develop hydroclimatological data download scripts for GAIA geoscience research

plugins.name: zarr-chunk-optimization
plugins.description: Benchmarking and optimization tools for Zarr chunking strategies on cloud object stores. Measures performance across access patterns and generates recommendations based on Nguyen et al. (2023) methodology.

plugins.name: zarr-data-format
plugins.description: Comprehensive agents and skills for working with the Zarr array storage format — creation, compression, cloud backends, xarray integration, and data migration

plugins.name: research-software-design
plugins.description: Agents and skills for Research-Through-Design approach to research software design

plugins.name: uiux-design-team
plugins.description: Comprehensive UI/UX design team simulation with 10 specialized agents covering the full design lifecycle. Includes user research with personas and JTBD, information architecture, interaction design, visual design with Claude's frontend-design aesthetic guidance, motion design, design systems with token architecture and component libraries, accessibility auditing with WCAG 2.2 compliance, UX writing, responsive design, CSS architecture, frontend component patterns for React/Vue/Svelte, usability evaluation with Nielsen's heuristics, design philosophies including Gestalt principles and emotional design, design case studies, user journey mapping, A/B testing strategy, design handoff, and design review orchestration.

plugins.name: containerization
plugins.description: Language-agnostic containerization for research software. Covers Dockerfile best practices, Podman, Singularity/Apptainer, Docker Compose, GPU containers, devcontainers, container registries, and container security scanning.

plugins.name: supply-chain-security
plugins.description: Supply-chain security plugin for research software. 2 agents (lead expert + incident responder), 5 commands (audit, incident, lockfile-check, pin-actions, harden-workflow), 6 skills covering hardened CI/CD, dependency security, threat awareness, SBOM/provenance, incident response, and ecosystem-specific quirks (npm, PyPI, conda/pixi, cargo, Go). Covers 2025-2026 campaigns: Shai-Hulud, TeamPCP, axios, LiteLLM .pth persistence.
